purpose: Keep the provider API below orchestration and adapters, keep concrete adapters isolated, and require reviewed evidence for every exceptional edge.

package_contracts.reason: The canonical provider boundary is the inward dependency root; sha2 is its only external crate, for canonical payload and receipt digest validation.
The fabric coordinates provider-neutral contracts only.
The Native adapter parses the provider-neutral observation envelope at its boundary, exposes a narrow application port, and owns no TraceDecay internals.
The NCM boundary may hash an opaque exact-scope namespace and validate canonical JSON payloads but cannot import TraceDecay internals.

Conformance remains provider-neutral and dashboard-independent; serde and serde_json load the deterministic scenario corpus and emit canonical baseline reports, sha2 binds fixture, corpus, and report identity digests, and tiktoken-rs counts admitted context tokens under the pinned o200k_base estimator identity.

The metric catalog is embedded JSON parsed with serde/serde_json, failures are typed with thiserror, the conformance baseline report is the production input, and the provider API supplies the canonical terminal-code vocabulary.
The default-off composition registry is the one product-owned crate allowed to construct the Native adapter behind the provider-neutral fabric.

The bounded observation journal persists delivery receipts through its own bundled rusqlite storage and exposes only the provider-neutral boundary; tempfile is a dev-dependency for isolated journal fixtures.

The hygiene pipeline mints into the provider API's receipt vocabulary, takes over the canonical JSON encoding owned by tracedecay-domain, and reuses the single vendored credential-detector corpus exposed through tracedecay-runtime-core's public surface instead of re-deriving it; both TraceDecay-internal edges are explicit, narrow, and reviewed rather than a general internals import.

rules.reason: The provider API can never depend on orchestration, adapters, the root crate, storage, or code-index packages.
Provider implementations and upstream internals stay outside the fabric.
The Native adapter cannot import another provider, root composition, persistence, or code-index internals.
The licensed NCM boundary receives only provider-neutral values and an opaque namespace.
The same harness must run every provider without importing a concrete adapter or product surface.
Metrics consume the provider-neutral baseline report and terminal vocabulary; they never import a concrete adapter, the root crate, storage, or code-index internals.
The composition registry may construct only the provider-neutral fabric and Native adapter, never stores, code indexes, hosts, transports, or the root crate.
The observation journal is a durable delivery-receipt ledger behind the provider-neutral boundary; it cannot import another provider, root composition, or upstream persistence internals.

The hygiene pipeline is a reviewed exception to the usual TraceDecay-internals ban: it may take over the canonical JSON encoding from tracedecay-domain and reuse the vendored credential detector corpus exposed by tracedecay-runtime-core's public surface, but no other TraceDecay-internal, NCM, or OCEAN package.
Public transports expose provider-neutral application contracts and never construct concrete providers.

rules: Exceptions authorize one exact direct edge and one exact rule only.
The ADR must exist under product/architecture/adr and reject provider-neutral alternatives.
Rationale, accountable owner, focused verification, and a dated review are mandatory.
Unused, duplicate, wildcard, or malformed exceptions fail validation.
